panels.title: Up / down per site
panels.description: Expected/Active come from the SAME queries as the removed 'Active vs. expected detector threads' panel, now shown per-site instead of as a time series. Each is gated with 'and on(instance) (up == 1)' at the PromQL level, so a DOWN site's row has no expected/active data at all -- not a stale or zero number, genuinely absent, matching 'meaningless to show when down'. A sustained active < expected gap on an UP site is the direct, dashboard-visible version of the 2-cameras-stuck-reconnecting pattern on jaeil_cr's second NVR unit.

panels.title: Container restarts (per site, over dashboard range)
panels.description: Sourced from cAdvisor's container_start_time_seconds via changes(). The 'and on(name) (... container_last_seen ... < 60)' clause keeps only the currently-alive container's series: Swarm's default task-history-limit keeps the last 5 exited task containers per service on the node, and cAdvisor keeps reporting their frozen last-known stats indefinitely -- without this filter, a site that crashed and restarted shows multiple 'spacenorm_obj_detection_<site>.<node>.<old-task-id>' series piled up on the same workernode (one live, the rest stale ghosts), none of which ever gets cleaned out of the panel. container_last_seen keeps updating (~ scrape_interval cadence) only for a container cAdvisor currently observes as running; 60s is 4x the 15s scrape_interval, comfortable margin against scrape jitter.

panels.title: Dynamic-config freshness (seconds since last successful fetch)
panels.description: Dynamic method only -- the direct, dashboard-visible answer to "is config_renew_period actually firing". No data for static-method sites is expected, not a gap.
